finite_design.authorization_boundary: This conditional scientific allocation is not a passing source qualification, exact manifest, official RAM preflight or execution claim. All are separately required before inference. No automatic expansion after80.

measurement.unchanged_treatment: Reuse the exact existing four-rate Style prompt and natural-conversation system instruction, structured dated self-report Facts and authentic earlier History. No output-dependent prompt/metric tuning or reference-answer injection.
measurement.human: Reuse the existing explicit0-3 plusNA rubric prospectively for this new package only. Primary relevance,coherence,linguistic resemblance; source-relative factual claim support/contradiction/unverifiability separately. Actual source evidence must make each intended judgment interpretable before generation. Historical99ratings are neither recoded nor used as semantic selection evidence.
measurement.applicability: No artificial factual question or unique gold answer is created. No claims is not perfect factual accuracy. Temporal consistency is NA unless evidence supports an actual time-specific comparison; a dated meeting alone is insufficient. Behavioral fidelity needs source support, not fluency.
measurement.technical: Native timing stages, output length, stop type and literal overlap remain technical diagnostics, not semantic success. Native timing definitions and arithmetic checks from the existing100 are reused. Global process peakRAM is not a per-condition causal effect.
measurement.controls: Freeze cyclic donor assignment and pooled selected-source style before targets, using the existing same-schema control. Document actual style-rate separations without selecting favorable donors, token differences without padding, and output lengths without posthoc matching.

analysis.contrasts: All7 frozen factorial contrasts plus3 correct-style comparisons, equal contexts within speaker then equal speakers. No favorable contrast selection.
analysis.uncertainty: Show paired speaker vectors, coverage and leave-one-speaker-out influence, plus source meeting/connected-group dependence. No calibrated confirmatory p-values or confidence intervals. Logical missing-outcome bounds only for prospectively defined applicable0-3 human outcomes, never the unresolved historical scale.
analysis.replication: Independent raw-to-results arithmetic after execution. Cross-corpus consistency of technical effects is distinct from semantic replication, actual-person disjointness and reviewer independence.

adversarial_limits: Four source speech rates may be a weak or generic instruction bundle, not a speaker representation. Similar donor rates could make a null contrast uninformative; report rather than optimize them.
F/H contain topic and style as well as facts; C0 common context already provides persona cues. Source provision is the estimand, not isolated latent psychological traits.
Source-qualified professional self-reports can be irrelevant to later conversation. Do not mistake factual-source availability for a valid factual-reliability endpoint in every case.
Shared partners and meetings, professional context, transcription differences and single small model limit generality. New-record transport is not universal Persona Fidelity validation.

go_pivot_stop.GO: Qualified source material, meaningful context/dossier, exact frozen treatment and safe hardware permit the bounded80 attempts even before human ratings exist.
go_pivot_stop.PIVOT_BEFORE_INFERENCE: If fewer than4 source-qualified speakers, inadequate target contexts or unjudgeable dossiers, preserve the failed qualification; do not repair source criteria or fill allocation with weak cases.
go_pivot_stop.STOP_EXPANSION: After80, no more same-method generation solely because token,copying,rate or latency effects moved. Expansion requires informative semantic evidence or separately justified precision/mechanism value.
go_pivot_stop.safety: Stop on RAM/disk/time/integrity/request failure. Preserve every attempt and partial journal; no hidden retries, unrelated application termination or altered hardware gates.
